Note: SOURCE-TRACKING JOIN (verified 2026-10-31). Myhrvold et al. 2015 is a compilation; every value traces to a primary study through this chain. (1) A value sits in Myhrvold_etal_2015_AmnioteDatabaseAug2015.csv at (class, order, family, genus, species, subspecies, trait). (2) The matching cell of Myhrvold_etal_2015_AmnioteDatabaseReferencesAug2015.csv holds the verbatim citation string for that value; the two files are row-for-row and taxon-for-taxon aligned (asserted by both build scripts). (3) Myhrvold_etal_2015_cell_references.R parses that string with the documented grammar (single | mean of A and B | K from median of N(pool) | mean of A & B from median of N(pool)) into reference_tables/Myhrvold_etal_2015_cell_references_part001..part007.csv -- 322572 rows, one per (cell x contributing reference), 0 parse failures -- carrying ref_key as printed, ref_key_norm (the 'BC <class> - ' prefix stripped), cell_form and derivation_role. (4) Join ref_key_norm to reference_tables/Myhrvold_etal_2015_references.csv (1003 distinct keys) for full_citation, matched against Supplemental_Materials/Supplemental_Table_1_Database_Literature_Cited.pdf: 924/1003 keys resolve matched_unique, 62 no_entry_found, 8 no_year_in_key, 9 ambiguous (candidates listed in Myhrvold_etal_2015_references_citation_candidates.csv). (5) For the individual records behind a value, use Myhrvold_etal_2015_AmnioteSparseTableAug2015.csv.

Definition: Unit of value, from the paper's own field-information table.
The value as reported by the single literature record on this row. Not a compiled or averaged value -- the compiled value for the species is in Amniote_Database_Aug_2015.csv.
Note: -999 is the published missing sentinel; such cells are dropped rather than carried.

Definition: The study this record came from, as printed in the published `dataset` column; blank where the publication prints -999 (20 records).
Note: RECORD-LEVEL SOURCE JOIN (verified 2026-10-31). This column is the published `dataset` string. Strip the leading 'BC <class> - ' prefix (BC Birds / BC mammals / BC Reptiles) and join on ref_key_norm in reference_tables/Myhrvold_etal_2015_references.csv: 1026 of the 1028 distinct strings resolve to a reference-key row, covering 273937/279439 records (98.0%). The two that do not are 'BC Reptiles -' (the compilers' blank record, an empty key) and 'Greer, A.E, 1997'. 947 of the resolved keys carry a full_citation matched from Supplemental_Materials/Supplemental_Table_1_Database_Literature_Cited.pdf, covering 238567/279439 records (85.4%); the remainder have a key but no entry found in that PDF. This is the shortest path from a trait value to the study it was measured in.
